presetHint: For a new show, use New or duplicate a preset, swap images (logo/background) and items, then Save template to reuse. Size (2000×3200) is printer-fixed.
helperHint: Fills items whose role is show / date / times (weekday auto). Change a role under each item’s ⚙.
imagesHint: Earlier images draw further back. Background stretches to full canvas; logos keep aspect ratio.
layoutHint: Margins affect wrap width (e.g. where the big date line breaks).
refHint: Overlay the real ticket image to fine-tune. Not included in the export.
opsBox:
How to
Edit items → Save PNG. Drag on the preview, or select and use arrow keys (Shift = 10px) to move.
Shortcuts Ctrl+Z undo · Ctrl+Shift+Z / Ctrl+Y redo · Ctrl+C/X/V copy/cut/paste · Ctrl+D duplicate · Del delete · Ctrl+S save PNG · Ctrl+Shift+S save template (⌘ on Mac)
histClearConfirm: Clear the undo history? (The current state is kept.)
guideHint: Drag a guide on the canvas to move it; drag it off the canvas to delete. Objects snap to guides while dragging (left/center/right · top/middle/bottom; hold Alt to disable). Ctrl+; toggles visibility. Guides are never exported.
presetLoadErr: Could not load presets/. Serve over HTTP (e.g. python -m http.server), or use “Load template” to open a JSON.
exportTaint: Export was blocked by a cross-origin logo URL without CORS. Use a same-origin or CORS-enabled URL, or upload the image instead.
attrHint: Lays out label/value pairs (seat-type, seat, name…) with uniform spacing. Tag members via each item’s ⚙ “In stack”.
alertNoRole: No item has a role (show/date/times). Set a role under an item’s ⚙.
